Retained earnings include a draft profit figure of $104 800. However, it has been discovered that
some errors had been made when preparing the statement of profit or loss.

which will end on 31 May 2025.

balance method instead of 20% per annum using the reducing balance method.

due on 28 February 2025.

Additional information

used. The following budgeted information is available.
per unit
selling price $108
direct materials 2.5 kg at $15.50 per kg

The company relies on one supplier who is currently only able to supply a limited quantity of direct
materials. As a result, the factory is producing 14 000 units per month, which is 70% of normal
capacity.
Currently, the supplier delivers direct materials 4 times each month. Each delivery incurs carriage
charges of $4300.
Fixed costs per month are forecast to be $136 000 including carriage charges.

parts.label: (e)
parts.text:

supplier.
